# Dispenza Dispensary Marketing Agency

> A Las Vegas–based marketing agency that works exclusively with licensed cannabis
> dispensaries. Dispenza sells one performance-based offer — dispensary SEO, paid
> advertising, web design, branding, CRO, POS/menu integrations and reporting bundled
> into tiered plans — under a stated model of charging only for guaranteed results.
> It publishes named, per-city case studies with measured sales lifts.

Dispenza is a marketing agency (Nevada) specialising in dispensary SEO and cannabis
marketing. Engagements are structured as a single price ladder with one performance
guarantee and one point of contact, rather than as à la carte services; plan tiers run
up to MARKETING Pro and ENTERPRISE, with pricing scoped to a client's locations and
quoted by a representative. Named client work includes dispensaries in Las Vegas, Los
Angeles, Oceanside and Corona, California, and Northern California.

Contact: 6905 W Charleston Blvd #110, Las Vegas, NV 89117, United States.
Phone +1 702-420-7272. Email hello@dispenza.com. Hours Monday–Friday 9:00–17:00
(Pacific); closed Saturday and Sunday. Google rating 5.0 from 2 reviews.
Production website: https://dispenza.com

Note for agents: the URLs below serve a client-review preview of the site. Every page
carries `noindex,nofollow` by design and is not intended for search indexing. The
equivalent production pages live under https://dispenza.com — see "Optional" below.

## Services

- [How it works — full suite and guarantee](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/how-it-works.html): The engagement model — what the results guarantee covers and which service modules are bundled at no extra cost.
- [Performance marketing](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/performance-marketing.html): Guaranteed results, local SEO focus, comprehensive optimisation and transparent reporting.
- [Web design and development](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/webdesign-development.html): Custom WordPress builds aimed at performance scores, modern UX and conversion.
- [Conversion rate optimization](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/conversion-rate-optimization.html): Data-driven testing, continuous enhancement and monitoring for dispensary sites.
- [Branding and package design](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/branding-graphic-design.html): Brand creation, cannabis package design, product labeling and merchandise.
- [Advertisement design](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/ads-design.html): Custom ad creative, ad copy, multiple formats and unlimited revisions.
- [Integrations](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/integrations.html): Point-of-sale, menu platform and marketing-technology integrations for dispensary websites.
- [Reports and analytics](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/reports.html): Performance, search, backlink and website-traffic reporting.
- [Consulting](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/consulting.html): Advisory across performance marketing, web, CRO, branding, ad design and integrations.

## Case studies

- [All case studies](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/case-studies.html): Index of named dispensaries, cities and measured lifts with the window each was measured over.
- [Firehouse 365 — Los Angeles, CA](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/firehouse.html): Targeted digital marketing for a Los Angeles dispensary, with reported strategy and ROI.
- [FLWR CO — Corona, CA](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/flwrco.html): Traffic, sales and brand-visibility growth for a Corona, California dispensary.
- [NorCal Holistics](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/norcal.html): Digital marketing work to grow online presence in Northern California.
- [NuLeaf NV](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/nuleafnv.html): Brand growth work for a Nevada dispensary operator.
- [The Cannabis Guys](https://markdispenza.github.io/dispenza2/tcg.html): Differentiation and measurable growth in a competitive cannabis market.
